title: Mishu's Pottery Studio
summary: Expanding a family pottery business with a second kiln and a small showroom.
story: We have run a small pottery business for three generations, making hand-painted cups, vases and planters from local clay. Demand has outgrown our single wood-fired kiln.
Your support will pay for a modern, energy-efficient kiln and a small showroom by the highway so travellers can buy directly from us instead of through middlemen.
Every backer gets our heartfelt thanks, and contributions above ৳2,000 receive a hand-painted cup from the first firing.

rewards.title: Thank-you card
rewards.description: A handwritten card from the Mishu family.

rewards.title: Hand-painted cup
rewards.description: A cup from the first firing of the new kiln.

rewards.title: Vase set
rewards.description: Three hand-painted vases, delivered anywhere in Dhaka.

updates.title: 93% there — thank you!
updates.body: We're almost fully funded. The kiln supplier has confirmed delivery for next month, and we've started clearing space for the showroom.

updates.title: First 100 backers
updates.body: We never expected this much support in the first week. Every one of you will get a personal thank-you card.

comments.body: Your cups are beautiful — can't wait for mine!
Thank you, Nusrat! The first firing is planned for next month.

title: Karim's Poultry Farm Expansion
summary: Doubling egg production with new cages, ventilation and a backup generator.
story: I started with 200 hens in a tin shed. Today we supply eggs to six local shops and a school canteen.
Heat waves and power cuts cost us birds every summer. This campaign funds better ventilation, a backup generator and 800 more laying hens.
With the expansion we will hire three more people from our village.

rewards.title: Farm-fresh eggs
rewards.description: Two trays of eggs, delivered in Mymensingh town.

rewards.title: Visit the farm
rewards.description: A guided morning on the farm with breakfast for two.

updates.title: Generator ordered
updates.body: Thanks to your support we've ordered the backup generator. No more lost birds during load-shedding this summer.

comments.body: Great to see local farms growing. Good luck, Karim bhai!

title: Tangail Handloom Collective
summary: Helping twelve weaving families sell their sarees online at fair prices.
story: Our collective of twelve weaving families makes traditional Tangail sarees on hand looms.
We want to build a simple online shop, buy better yarn in bulk and pay for product photography so our work reaches buyers across the country.
Funds are shared transparently between all member families.

rewards.title: Handloom scarf
rewards.description: A cotton scarf woven by the collective.

rewards.title: Tangail saree
rewards.description: A full handloom saree in the colour of your choice.

title: Retro Cafe
summary: A cosy burger and coffee spot for students, with live music on weekends.
story: Retro Cafe started as a food cart outside the university gate. Our burgers sold out every evening.
We have found a small space nearby and need help with the kitchen fit-out, furniture and the first three months of rent.
Backers get a free meal on opening week and their names on our wall of founders.

rewards.title: Opening-week meal
rewards.description: A burger and coffee on us during opening week.

rewards.title: Wall of founders
rewards.description: Your name on our founders' wall, plus the opening-week meal.

title: Mayer Dowa Jewellery
summary: Two sisters turning their market stall into a proper handmade jewellery shop.
story: We make and sell handmade bangles, earrings and necklaces from a small stall in New Market.
This campaign will fund display cases, tools and stock for a permanent shop front so we can serve customers all year round.

rewards.title: Handmade bangles
rewards.description: A pair of bangles made to your size.

title: Untitled Boutique House
summary: Affordable, locally tailored everyday wear designed in Rajshahi.
story: I design simple, comfortable everyday clothes and work with four local tailors.
Funding will buy two industrial sewing machines and fabric for our first full collection.
